subject: How to constrain the unique variances of several indicators to be equal to 1 in categorical CFA

messages.author: e4229b562b67d5ac
messages.subject: How to constrain the unique variances of several indicators to be equal to 1 in categorical CFA
parts:
I am running an ordered categorical CFA model using lavaan, and wanted to constrain the unique variances of the latent response variables underlying several ordered categorical indicators to be equal to 1. 

The latent variables are defined thus:

# latent variable definitions
C1FAMo =~ NA*c1mas03 + c1mas11 + 1*c1mas21 + c1mas29 + c1mas38
C2FAMo =~ NA*c2mas03 + c2mas11 + 1*c2mas21 + c2mas29 + c2mas38

And there were some threshold constraints to inform R that all the indicators are ordered categorical.

I wrote the following scripts to constrain the unique variances of the latent response variables underlying several ordered categorical indicators to be equal to 1:

# Unique Variances
# Fix Unique Variances at T1 to 1.00
c1mas03 ~~ 1*c1mas03
c1mas11 ~~ 1*c1mas11
c1mas21 ~~ 1*c1mas21
c1mas29 ~~ 1*c1mas29
c1mas38 ~~ 1*c1mas38

What I get from the output is 
Variances:
    c1mas03           0.761
    c1mas11           0.484
    c1mas21           0.655
    c1mas29           0.728
    c1mas38           0.766

I was wondering if anyone can tell me whether it is possible to fix the unique variance of the latent response variable underlying an ordered categorical indicator? If so, how can I do it?

Thanks a lot!

Yu

messages.author: af82fa98896529e2
messages.subject: Re: How to constrain the unique variances of several indicators to be equal to 1 in categorical CFA
parts:
Probably, you have not specified the parameterization argument as "theta". That is, you should have the cfa function (or other lavaan functions) as

fit <- cfa(myModel, myData, ordered = myVariableList, parameterization = "theta", estimator = "wlsmv")

Sunthud
